hotSeat.q: Why should we trust a company that's smaller than our IT department?
hotSeat.de: Warum sollten wir einer Firma trauen, die kleiner ist als unsere IT-Abteilung?
hotSeat.model: That's a fair question. Size matters less than track record: we have run over 300 projects like yours, and I can connect you with two customers of your size.

tip.de: Die Sorge anerkennen, dann mit Belegen antworten.
tip.en: Acknowledge the concern, then answer with evidence.

hotSeat.q: What happens to our data if your company goes bankrupt?
hotSeat.de: Was passiert mit unseren Daten, wenn Ihre Firma pleitegeht?
hotSeat.model: Good question. Your data always belongs to you: you can export everything in standard formats at any time, and our contract includes a clear exit plan.

tip.de: Sachlich bleiben und die Absicherung nennen.
tip.en: Stay factual and name the safeguard.

hotSeat.q: Your numbers look too good. Where do they come from?
hotSeat.de: Ihre Zahlen sehen zu gut aus. Woher kommen sie?
hotSeat.model: I'm glad you asked. They come from a customer project with Hartmann Foods, and I'd suggest we check them with your own data in a pilot.

tip.de: Quelle nennen und einen Test anbieten.
tip.en: Name the source and offer a test.

hotSeat.q: Why is your solution more expensive than the others?
hotSeat.de: Warum ist Ihre Lösung teurer als die anderen?
hotSeat.model: Let me put it this way: our price includes hosting, updates, and support. When you compare the total cost over three years, we are usually lower.

tip.de: Den Vergleich auf die Gesamtkosten lenken.
tip.en: Move the comparison to total cost.

hotSeat.q: Can your employees read our documents?
hotSeat.de: Können Ihre Mitarbeiter unsere Dokumente lesen?
hotSeat.model: No, they can't. Documents are encrypted, and access is logged. Only if you ask us for support can an administrator see what you share with them.

tip.de: Kurz und klar antworten, dann erklären.
tip.en: Answer short and clear, then explain.

hotSeat.q: Why should we act now if the deadline is in 2027?
hotSeat.de: Warum sollten wir jetzt handeln, wenn die Frist erst 2027 ist?
hotSeat.model: That's a great question. Most projects take six to nine months, and partners will be fully booked close to the deadline, so starting now saves time and money.

tip.en: Answer with facts about project time.

hotSeat.q: Honestly, what is the difference between you and a shared drive?
hotSeat.de: Ehrlich, was ist der Unterschied zwischen Ihnen und einem Netzlaufwerk?
hotSeat.model: Fair point, both store files. The difference is what happens next: search, approvals, retention rules, and an audit trail. A shared drive stores; we manage.

tip.de: Die Gemeinsamkeit zugeben, dann den Unterschied zuspitzen.
tip.en: Admit what is similar, then sharpen the difference.

hotSeat.q: How long will the rollout really take?
hotSeat.de: Wie lange dauert die Einführung wirklich?
hotSeat.model: Let me be realistic: the pilot takes six weeks, and a full rollout usually takes four to six months, depending on how many departments are involved.

tip.en: Stay realistic and give a range.

hotSeat.q: Why is the forecast lower than last quarter?
hotSeat.de: Warum ist die Prognose niedriger als im letzten Quartal?
hotSeat.model: Good question. Two large deals moved into the next quarter, but both are still active, and we expect to close them in January.

tip.en: Name the cause and give an outlook.

hotSeat.model: Let me think about that for a second. It depends on the contract length: for three years, I can offer ten percent less per user.

tip.de: Nicht sofort eine Zahl nennen, sondern eine Bedingung.
tip.en: Do not name a number right away; name a condition.

hotSeat.q: Why would our consultants want to learn yet another product?
hotSeat.de: Warum sollten unsere Berater noch ein Produkt lernen wollen?
hotSeat.model: That's a fair concern. The training takes two days, and after that, most partners see it as an easy add-on that clients are already asking for.

tip.en: Name the effort honestly and set the benefit against it.

hotSeat.q: How can you promise October 2 when you already missed one deadline?
hotSeat.de: Wie können Sie den 2. Oktober versprechen, wenn Sie schon eine Frist verpasst haben?
hotSeat.model: You're right to ask. This time the date is based on files we've already tested, and you'll get an update from me every Friday, so you'll see early if anything changes.

tip.de: Recht geben, dann erklären, warum es diesmal anders ist.
tip.en: Agree, then explain why this time is different.

hotSeat.q: Isn't AI going to make your product unnecessary?
hotSeat.de: Macht KI Ihr Produkt nicht bald überflüssig?
hotSeat.model: It's a bit more nuanced than that. AI needs clean, well-organized documents to work, and that is exactly what our system provides.

tip.de: Die Frage umdrehen: KI braucht die Grundlage.
tip.en: Turn the question around: AI needs the foundation.

hotSeat.q: Why should we pay more for the new version?
hotSeat.de: Warum sollten wir für die neue Version mehr bezahlen?
hotSeat.model: That's a fair question. You only pay more if you use the new modules; your current package stays at the same price.

hotSeat.q: Who else are you talking to in our company?
hotSeat.de: Mit wem sprechen Sie sonst noch in unserem Unternehmen?
hotSeat.model: Good question, and I'm happy to be transparent. So far, only with you and your IT manager. Who else should be involved?

tip.de: Offen antworten und die Frage zurückgeben.
tip.en: Answer openly and hand the question back.
